Name: Water Trough Slime Hutch
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a Content Patcher map modification to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13778]Slime Hutch Water Spots[/url]. It adds water troughs around the perimeter of the room, suitable for filling with iridium sprinklers (or watering cans for the brave).

Requires Content Patcher.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]
